operation.effect: Creates one issue in the host-chosen repository, labelled vater-external-evidence. The evidence run closes each issue it creates.
operation.local_identifier: The issue body carries the line 'vater-operation-id: {operation_id}'.
operation.approval: Every dispatch needs a host-issued ledger approval bound to the exact arguments. In the evidence workflow, a person triggering the run is that approval.

idempotency.evidence: No idempotency key is documented for creating an issue, and conditional requests are not supported for unsafe methods such as POST unless an endpoint says otherwise.
idempotency.consequence: A create that may have executed is never sent again.

retry_policy.resend_only_when: The destination answered with a rate-limit error, which means the request did not execute: HTTP 403 or 429 with a retry-after header or x-ratelimit-remaining 0.
retry_policy.wait: retry-after seconds when present; else until x-ratelimit-reset when x-ratelimit-remaining is 0; else at least 60 seconds.
never_resend_after: any reply other than a rate-limit error
retry_policy.pacing: Requests are made serially, and the evidence run waits at least one second between mutating requests.

result_lookup.by_operation_id: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues?labels=vater-external-evidence&state=all&since={dispatch time minus 300 seconds}&per_page=100, at most 10 pages, skipping pull requests, matched on the exact marker line
result_lookup.consistency: GitHub does not document read-after-write consistency for the list endpoint, so zero matches does not prove the issue was not created.
result_lookup.on_exactly_one_match: Record the issue as the result of the operation.
result_lookup.on_zero_or_many_matches_or_lookup_failur: HUMAN_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED; the ledger keeps the operation unknown.

resource_version.recorded: Issue number, node_id, updated_at, the ETag of GET /issues/{number}, and the SHA-256 of title, body and labels, stored with the operation id.
resource_version.target_check: The issue is not a pull request, carries the label, has exactly the requested title and contains the operation's marker line. Any mismatch is TARGET_MISMATCH and requires human reconciliation.

evidence_status.live_runs: Run by .github/workflows/external-change-evidence.yml with the job's GITHUB_TOKEN (issues: write). Not yet executed.
